translations.web: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
translations.bsb: Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—
translations.kjv: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
